blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Minimum wage earners in Western Visayas will receive daily pay increases of up to P45 starting Nov. 19, following the approval of a new wage order by the Department of Labor and Employment. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino on Tuesday said that the National Wages and Productivity Commission (NWPC) approved Wage Order No. VI-30 following consultations between workers and employers. READ: Calabarzon workers get P45 wage hike Under the new order, workers in non-agricultural, industrial, and commercial establishments employing more than 10 workers will receive a P40 increase, raising their daily minimum wage from P550 to P590.
